title: PolyWeb3Mail
tagline: A decentralized email and web3 platform where you can send encrypted email
description:
Problem with Web2 Email:
- Email content are not encrypt
- You do not own your email content
- Annoying advertisement

PolyWeb3Mail
- Send and store emails in a decentralized way
- Emails are encrypted and stored on IPFS
- Does not collect your data
- Only user can access and decrypt their email content
 
How it works:
- Email content are encrypt with Lit Protocol
- Encrypted email content are stored on IPFS
- CID of the encrypted email content are stored on Tableland
how_its_made:
I built the front end with React and Material-UI for styling.  I built the contract with Hardhat.  I deploy my contract on Polygon Testnet.

I used the following technologies:
- IPFS - Encrypted email content are stored on IPFS using nft.storage
- Lit Protocol - Email content are encrypt using Lit Protocol 
- Tableland - CID of the encrypted email content are stored on Tableland
- Polygon - I deployed the contract on Polygon Testnet for cheap gas fee 
- NFT Port - To send NFT for free  on Polygon
- POAP - Allow user to send  POAP mint link
- Valist- Published Website on Valist.io => https://app.valist.io/songweb3/polyweb3mail
